title: Recording editor
welcomeSelect: Select a meeting from the list.
welcomeEdit: Choose which intervals to keep and where to replace audio with a beep. Saving creates backups and updates events.xml and the referenced raw audio.
manualRebuild: Administrators rebuild and publish recordings manually.
reviewCounts: Keep: {record, plural, one {# interval} other {# intervals}} / Beep: {beep, plural, one {# interval} other {# intervals}}
reviewDetails: Back up events.xml and write new recording start/stop events. For microphone and screen sharing audio that overlaps beep intervals, back up the originals, create files with new names, and update the XML references.
needRange: Choose at least one interval to keep. BigBlueButton cannot safely handle an empty recording, so saving is disabled.
externalAudio: External video audio is not included in the raw audio and cannot be replaced with a beep.
audioError: Cannot load the preview audio. Reload the meeting.
dragHint: Drag the waveform to select an interval. Drag its edges to adjust it.
invalidTime: Enter times within the meeting, with start < end
wavePending: The waveform appears after preview generation
draftSaved: Draft saved. Raw data has not been changed.
rawSaved: Saved. XML backup: {backup}. Administrators must rebuild the recording manually with bbb-record.
recentHint: Past 14 days · missing raw data is flagged
selectionHidden: The selected meeting is hidden by the filter. Its editor remains open.
saveBeforeSwitch: Save a draft or save to raw before switching meetings.
videoError: The browser cannot play this video ({file}).
invalidShapes: Cannot display {count, plural, one {# shape} other {# shapes}}. Original events will be preserved when saving.
shapeError: Cannot display the drawings. Original events will be preserved when saving.
